requirement_plain_english: Passwords follow current NIST guidance (length over complexity, no forced rotation, block common/breached passwords)
test_procedure: Read IT-004 and compare each rule to NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2. Filter the AD export for password_never_expires = True and count the accounts.
where_to_look: Password policy, interview: IT Manager, AD export

requirement_plain_english: MFA is required for all users on email, remote access (VPN), and admin accounts
test_procedure: Filter the M365 MFA report for enabled accounts with mfa_status = Disabled and count them. Check every account with an admin role. Ask how VPN logins work.
where_to_look: M365 MFA report, interview: IT Manager, insurer requirements, Bayside questionnaire

requirement_plain_english: Accounts are disabled promptly when people leave, and company equipment is returned
test_procedure: Match every name on the HR terminations list to the AD export, the M365 report, the LedgerPoint list, and the PayNest portal list. Count who is still enabled, and check the sign-in log for logins after the termination date. Check the laptop inventory for unreturned devices.
where_to_look: HR terminations vs. AD export, laptop inventory, interview: HR Director, LedgerPoint access list, PayNest portal users, sign-in audit log

requirement_plain_english: Admin rights are limited to people who need them; every admin uses their own named account (no shared accounts)
test_procedure: For each Domain Admins member, decide: named or shared? still employed? needs admin for their job? Do the same for M365 Global Administrators.
where_to_look: Domain Admins export, M365 report, interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: User access is reviewed at least once a year
test_procedure: Ask for the last access review and its sign-off. If none exists, the control fails.
where_to_look: Interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: All systems run software the vendor still supports
test_procedure: Look up the end-of-support date for every OS in the server and laptop inventories. List anything past its date.
where_to_look: Server inventory, laptop inventory

requirement_plain_english: Security patches are applied on time (within 30 days)
test_procedure: Count laptops and servers whose last_patch_date is more than 30 days before the assessment date (Nov 2, 2026).
where_to_look: Laptop inventory, server inventory, interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: Laptops are encrypted, especially any that may hold CUI
test_procedure: Count laptops with BitLocker Off. Cross-check those users against the departments that handle CUI.
where_to_look: Laptop inventory, interview: Gov Programs

requirement_plain_english: CUI and company data are stored and shared only on approved systems (no personal cloud accounts)
test_procedure: Compare where CUI actually goes (interviews, vendor list) with the acceptable use policy rule on approved systems.
where_to_look: Interview: Gov Programs, vendor list, acceptable use policy

requirement_plain_english: Backups are monitored, kept in a separate location, and test-restored at least once a year
test_procedure: Count failed jobs in the backup log, check whether anyone opened a ticket, check offsite_copy, and ask for proof of a restore test.
where_to_look: Backup job log, server inventory, interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: All employees complete security awareness training every year; CUI handlers also complete CUI training
test_procedure: Calculate the percent of employees who completed annual training. Calculate the percent of CUI handlers (Operations + Government Programs) who completed the CUI module.
where_to_look: Training completion report, interview: HR Director, interview: AP Clerk

requirement_plain_english: A current incident response plan exists, is reviewed yearly, and is tested
test_procedure: Check the IR plan's review date, test date, and contact list. Do the people and steps still exist?
where_to_look: Incident response plan, the-incident.md

requirement_plain_english: Incidents are documented and reported to everyone who must be told (DFARS: 72 hours)
test_procedure: Compare the incident timeline with the 72-hour DFARS rule. Use the sign-in log to decide whether CUI was in the attacker's reach.
where_to_look: the-incident.md, Northstar letter, interview: Gov Programs, sign-in audit log

requirement_plain_english: Security logs are kept long enough and reviewed regularly
test_procedure: Ask about log retention and review. Load the sign-in log into Splunk and see whether a reviewer would have caught the Sept 8 and Sept 24 events.
where_to_look: Interview: IT Manager, sign-in audit log (Splunk)

requirement_plain_english: Vendors with access to sensitive data are reviewed for security before and during the contract
test_procedure: For each vendor in the vendor list, check for a security review, a current SOC 2, and security terms in the contract. Read the Bayside and PayNest documents.
where_to_look: Vendor list, interview: CFO, Bayside questionnaire + contract, PayNest SOC 2 summary

requirement_plain_english: Security policies have an owner, are approved, and are reviewed every year
test_procedure: For each policy, record the owner, approval, and last review date.
where_to_look: All three policies, interview: CFO

requirement_plain_english: A System Security Plan (SSP) describes the systems that handle CUI and how each requirement is met
test_procedure: Ask for the SSP. If none exists, the control fails.
where_to_look: Northstar letter, interview: Gov Programs

requirement_plain_english: Known security gaps are tracked in a Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) or risk register
test_procedure: Ask for the POA&M or risk register.
where_to_look: Interviews: Gov Programs, CFO

requirement_plain_english: An accurate inventory shows every device and where CUI is stored
test_procedure: Can you name every device and location that holds CUI using the inventories alone? If people have to guess, the control fails.
where_to_look: Laptop and server inventories, interview: Gov Programs

requirement_plain_english: EDR or antivirus runs on every laptop and server
test_procedure: Count devices where edr_agent is not Installed. Confirm with the EDR console.
where_to_look: Laptop inventory, interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: New hires are background-checked before they start
test_procedure: Sample 5 personnel files and confirm the background check date is before the start date.
where_to_look: Interview: HR Director

requirement_plain_english: Physical access to the office is controlled and visitors are logged
test_procedure: Observe the badge reader and visitor log on site.
where_to_look: Interview: HR Director

requirement_plain_english: Firewall rules are reviewed on a schedule
test_procedure: Get the most recent quarterly firewall review report and confirm it is less than 90 days old.
where_to_look: Interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: No single person can both change vendor bank details and approve or release payments (separation of duties), and bank changes are verified by calling a known phone number
test_procedure: In the LedgerPoint access list, find anyone with change_vendor_bank_details AND approve_payments or release_payments. Review the vendor bank change log for unverified changes.
where_to_look: LedgerPoint access list, vendor bank change log, vendor list, interview: AP Clerk

requirement_plain_english: Access to CUI folders is limited to the people whose jobs need it (least privilege)
test_procedure: List every group and user with access to \\FS01\GovPrograms. Count how many people can read CUI, and compare that to the 5 current Government Programs employees in the AD export.
where_to_look: GovPrograms share permissions, Domain Admins export, interview: Gov Programs

requirement_plain_english: Information is classified, and systems that hold CUI are identified and given a security category
test_procedure: Ask whether Tidewell labels data (CUI, confidential, public) and has categorized its systems. Then do the FIPS 199 categorization yourself in 03-my-work/rmf/.
where_to_look: Server inventory, interview: Gov Programs, Northstar letter
